lead: Every rocket India has sent towards space, on one chart: the failures, the comebacks and what flies next.
try: Tap any dot on the big chart to read the story of that launch.
points: India's first rocket to reach orbit failed in 1979, then succeeded in 1980.
New rockets often fail at first and get better with every flight.
Coming up next: Gaganyaan test flights, then Indian astronauts on an Indian rocket.
